question: Where can I get mining rights in the United States (exploration permits and mining concessions) as geometry, with holder, commodity, status and dates?

answer.summary: BLM's MLRS publishes 598,739 non-closed mining claims as polygons (ArcGIS REST and bulk CSV/GeoJSON) with case number, claim type and status, but the polygons are built from PLSS legal descriptions, not staked perimeters, and the layer has no holder, commodity or grant dates. Other BLM layers (notices, plans of operations, leases) add commodity, effective/expiry dates (often blank) and a customer-name field. Alaska DNR publishes 123,061 state claim polygons with status only.
main_caveats: BLM claim polygons come from legal land descriptions on the PLSS: two 20.66-acre sample claims map to 396-acre polygons; 45,527 have staff-edited geometry (score 100).
The claims layer has no holder, commodity or grant/expiry date; BLM_PROD is the claim type (lode, placer, mill site, tunnel site), not a mineral.
A claim or permit status ('Active', 'Authorized') shows legal standing only; it does not show that a mine is operating or that minerals exist.
14,997 of 598,739 BLM claim rows have no geometry and 11,821 have no quality score; Closed claims are a separate layer of 79,294 records.
EFF_DT and EXP_DT are blank in most notice, plan and lease records (EXP_DT filled in 760 of 1,252 notices but only 13 of 1,122 plans).
Holder names exist in some BLM layers (CUST_NM_SEC) and in redacted MLRS reports; this card describes availability only and copies no names.
answer.confidence_reason: BLM and Alaska layers were queried and counted; MLRS report contents, other states and the claim-level date fields were not opened.

attributes.note: Polygon per case: 583,742 of 598,739 BLM claims (PLSS-derived; a 20.66-acre claim maps to ~396 acres) and 123,061 Alaska state claims.
attributes.gap_note: BLM says staked boundaries are only in the Notice/Certificate of Location in each case file; the published polygons follow quarter sections, so they are not legal perimeters.

attributes.note: No holder field in the claims layer; CUST_NM_SEC exists in BLM notice, plan and lease layers (e.g. 811 of 1,122 plans). Names are not reproduced here.
attributes.gap_note: MLRS Customer Info reports are redacted for privacy; unredacted ones need a Login.gov account (not created). Alaska's layer points to a separate LAS case-file site.

attributes.note: Claims layer only gives claim type (Lode 502,742; Placer 79,776; Mill Site 15,891); CMMDTY is filled in 1,199 of 1,252 notices and 1,103 of 1,122 plans.
attributes.gap_note: No commodity per mining claim in the layer; claim type is not a mineral, and notices and plans cover far fewer rights than claims.

attributes.note: BLM CSE_DISP (claims: Active 425,853, Filed 166,316, Under Review 6,326); Alaska CS_LABEL ISSUED 41,160, CLOSED 81,863, SUSPEND 33.
EFF_DT, EXP_DT and CSE_DISP_DT exist in permit and lease layers but are sparse (EXP_DT 13 of 1,122 plans); claims and Alaska layers carry no grant or expiry date.
attributes.gap_note: Claims layer only has record Created/Modified stamps; MLRS Case Action(s) reports might hold location and filing dates but were not run (application page only).

members_summary.scope_note: The HUB folder lists about 20 MLRS layers; six were queried and five profiled. Oil, gas, geothermal, oil shale, land-use and withdrawal layers were not opened.

if_unstructured.summary: Staked claim boundaries, location dates and holder names sit in each BLM case file (Notice or Certificate of Location) and in MLRS reports, not in the polygon layer.
